Chair Core & Abs Fat Loss Workout

An intense home core routine utilizing a simple chair to sculpt upper abs, lower abs, and obliques. Perform each movement for high reps to maximize calorie burn and core definition.

15–20 min
Duration
5
Exercises
1 Circuit (3–4 Rounds)
Blocks
Intermediate Chair Yoga Mat
0 of 5 done

Exercise Flow

Check off each exercise as you complete sets. Rest timer at the bottom.
01

Seated Straight Leg Lifts

4 × 25 reps
Upper AbsRectus AbdominisHip Flexors
  • Sit on the floor with hands behind hips for support
  • Keep legs straight and lift them vertically towards the chair height

Why: Engages the entire abdominal wall with emphasis on upper core stability.

02

Seated Knee Tucks

4 × 25 reps
Lower AbsRectus Abdominis
  • Pull knees close into the chest while leaning torso back slightly
  • Extend legs forward without letting heels touch the floor

Why: Targets lower abdominal fibers to build core strength and definition.

03

Seated Alternating Leg Extensions

4 × 25 reps
Lower AbsObliquesHip Flexors
  • Maintain a lean-back position supported by your hands
  • Kick legs back and forth in an alternating fluid motion under the chair

Why: Enhances V-line definition and hip flexor control.

04

Seated Scissor Kicks

4 × 25 reps
ObliquesLower Abs
  • Keep legs elevated slightly off the mat
  • Criss-cross your legs horizontally in a rhythmic motion

Why: Fires up the obliques and transverse abdominis through horizontal abduction/adduction.

05

Chair Elevated Crunches

4 × 25 reps
Upper AbsCore
  • Rest calves elevated on the chair seat with knees bent at 90 degrees
  • Lift shoulders off the floor and reach forward toward the chair

Why: Isolates upper abs by removing momentum and lower body involvement.

Trainer Tips

  • Complete 3 to 4 full rounds of all 5 exercises with a 60-second rest between rounds.
  • Perform this session 3 times weekly alongside a controlled diet for maximum results.
